nodes.name: icon styles.csv
nodes.summary: Icon styles CSV dataset for design system icon library: defines style variants (outline, filled, sharp, rounded, two-tone), weight mappings, size scales, and usage guidelines for 105 searchable icons in ui-ux-pro-max.

nodes.name: cip core.py
nodes.summary: CIP (Component Instance Protocol) core Python module defining base classes for component generation: ComponentSpec, Variant, Slot, Prop, and render logic. Shared by generate.py and render-html.py for design system component code generation.

nodes.name: cip generate.py
nodes.summary: CIP component generation script: reads component specifications from CSV/data files, instantiates ComponentSpec objects, and outputs React/TypeScript component code with props, variants, slots, and TypeScript interfaces.

nodes.name: cip render-html.py
nodes.summary: CIP HTML rendering script: generates interactive HTML previews for design system components with variant selectors, prop controls, and live editing. Used for component documentation and visual regression testing.

nodes.name: cip search.py
nodes.summary: CIP component search script: provides CLI search over component library with filters for category, props, variants, and framework. Returns matching component specs for use in design-system queries.

nodes.name: icon generate.py
nodes.summary: Icon generation script: processes SVG icon sources, applies style transformations (outline/filled/sharp/rounded/two-tone), optimizes with SVGO, and outputs React component wrappers with consistent props (size, color, strokeWidth).

nodes.name: logo core.py
nodes.summary: Logo generation core module: defines LogoSpec with variants (primary, secondary, mark, wordmark), color modes (light, dark, mono), size scales, clear space rules, and export formats (SVG, PNG, favicon).

nodes.name: logo generate.py
nodes.summary: Logo generation script: reads brand configuration (colors, typography, icon), applies LogoSpec templates, generates all variant combinations, and exports production-ready assets with correct naming and directory structure.

nodes.name: logo search.py
nodes.summary: Logo search script: queries logo variant library by category (primary/mark/wordmark), color mode, and usage context. Returns matching LogoSpec for design-system integration and brand consistency checks.

nodes.name: cip deliverables.csv
nodes.summary: CIP deliverables CSV: defines component deliverable types (component, pattern, template, page-section) with required specs, documentation standards, and acceptance criteria for design system contributions.

nodes.name: cip industries.csv
nodes.summary: CIP industries CSV: maps industry verticals (fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, SaaS, enterprise) to recommended component patterns, color schemes, compliance requirements, and design priorities.

nodes.name: cip mockup-contexts.csv
nodes.summary: CIP mockup contexts CSV: defines presentation contexts for component previews (mobile, desktop, tablet, dark-mode, high-contrast, RTL) with viewport settings and device frame configurations.

nodes.name: cip styles.csv
nodes.summary: CIP styles CSV: defines visual style tokens (color palettes, spacing scales, typography, borders, shadows, radius) with semantic names and CSS variable mappings for design system theming.

nodes.name: logo colors.csv
nodes.summary: Logo colors CSV: defines brand color palette with primary/secondary/accent/neutral roles, hex values, usage ratios, accessibility contrast ratios, and color-blind safe alternatives.

nodes.name: logo industries.csv
nodes.summary: Logo industries CSV: maps industries to logo style recommendations (minimal, bold, playful, corporate, tech) with rationale and example brand references for logo generation guidance.

nodes.name: logo styles.csv
nodes.summary: Logo styles CSV: defines logo style categories (wordmark, lettermark, pictorial, abstract, emblem, combination) with structural characteristics, scalability ratings, and industry fit scores.
